connector.name: Amrood - INR Payments for AI Agents
connector.registryDescription: KYC-verified INR wallets for AI agents in India. Payments, escrow, and settlements.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package amrood-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the saurabh-karn account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.description: Amrood API base URL (defaults to https://api.amrood.io)
